name: Mother Says
source:
A life form awakens in an opposite universe and has only five days to grow before Mother names it – fixing the course of its life. Discover 568365’s journey toward self-understanding in a world of strangeness.

[From [url=https://canaanthedoll.itch.io/mother-says]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一种生命形式在相反的宇宙中苏醒，只有五天的时间才能成长，然后母亲命名它——确定它的生命轨迹。探索568365在陌生的世界中了解自我的旅程。

[来自[url=https://canaanthedoll.itch.io/mother-says]Itch.io[/url]]
